Anatomy Ballistics — 1.1.0 COMPLETE

Save / load on iPad:
1. Unzip this archive
2. You should see a folder named AnatomyBallistics.codea
3. Files app → On My iPad → Codea
4. Copy AnatomyBallistics.codea into that Codea folder
5. Open Codea → tap AnatomyBallistics → Play (landscape)

Double-tap to shoot · RESET rebuilds · NEXT advances range stages
